meaning_en: During the dark hours of the day.
example_en: Stars are visible at night.
examples_extra: Owls sleep during the day and hunt at night.
The streets are quiet at night in our town.
note_fa: the ندارد: at night، نه at the night.

meaning_en: The land along the side of a river.
example_en: We sat on the river bank and watched the boats.
examples_extra: We sat on the bank of the river and watched the boats.
Trees grow thick along both banks of the wide river.
note_fa: با bank «بانک پول» فرق دارد — ساحل رودخانه است.

meaning_en: A part of a tree that grows from the trunk.
example_en: A bird built its nest on a tree branch.
examples_extra: A heavy branch broke off in the storm.
Small birds were singing on the high branches.

meaning_en: An area protected for its natural beauty.
example_en: We visited a beautiful conservation area.
examples_extra: The village is inside a conservation area.
You cannot build new houses in a conservation area.

meaning_en: A small house, usually in the countryside.
example_en: We stayed in a small cottage by the sea.
examples_extra: They live in a small cottage near the lake.
My friend bought a cottage in the countryside.

meaning_en: A nation with its own government and land.
example_en: France is a beautiful country.
examples_extra: Which country are you from?
Canada is a very large country.

meaning_en: A small road in the countryside, not a main road.
example_en: We drove down a quiet country road.
examples_extra: We drove along a narrow country road.
The country road was full of holes.

meaning_en: Land outside towns, with fields and trees.
example_en: I love walking in the countryside.
examples_extra: We spent the weekend in the countryside.
She loves walking in the countryside.

meaning_en: A plant grown in large amounts for food.
example_en: Wheat is an important crop.
examples_extra: Farmers are hoping for a good wheat crop this year.
The dry weather badly damaged the rice crop.
note_fa: محصول زراعی؛ جمع آن crops است.

meaning_en: A place where food is grown or animals are kept.
example_en: My uncle lives on a big farm.
examples_extra: They grow wheat on their farm.
The children visited a farm last week.

meaning_en: A person who works on a farm.
example_en: The farmer grows corn and wheat.
examples_extra: The farmer grows rice in the fields.
Farmers work very hard in summer.

meaning_en: A house on a farm.
example_en: We stayed in a lovely farmhouse for our holiday.
examples_extra: They bought an old farmhouse in the village.
The farmhouse has a big garden.

meaning_en: The business of growing crops or raising animals.
example_en: Farming is hard work but important.
examples_extra: Farming is the main job in this region.
He learned farming from his father.

meaning_en: A barrier made of wood or wire.
example_en: The garden has a wooden fence around it.
examples_extra: The dog jumped over the fence.
They built a wooden fence around the garden.

meaning_en: An area of land used for crops or animals.
example_en: Cows are grazing in the green field.
examples_extra: Cows were grazing in the field.
The children played in the field.

meaning_en: A path for people to walk on.
example_en: We walked along the narrow footpath.
examples_extra: A narrow footpath leads through the woods.
Walk on the footpath, not on the road.

meaning_en: a large area with many trees.
example_en: We walked in the forest.
examples_extra: We went for a walk in the forest.
Many animals live in the forest.

meaning_en: clean air outside.
example_en: Let's go outside for some fresh air.
examples_extra: Open the window and get some fresh air.
We need some fresh air after the long meeting.

meaning_en: a part of a fence or wall that opens.
example_en: Please close the gate behind you.
examples_extra: Please close the gate behind you.
The farmer opened the gate for the sheep.
note_fa: درِ حصار/باغ؛ door برای درِ ساختمان است.

meaning_en: To travel over snow on skis.
example_en: I want to go skiing in the mountains.
examples_extra: We go skiing every winter.
Let's go skiing next weekend.

meaning_en: To walk for pleasure, often in nature.
example_en: We love to go walking in the mountains.
examples_extra: We go walking in the park.
They often go walking on Sundays.

meaning_en: common green plant covering fields and lawns.
example_en: The sheep are eating grass.
examples_extra: The cows eat fresh grass.
Don't walk on the grass!

meaning_en: the surface of the earth.
example_en: The ball fell to the ground.
examples_extra: The children sat on the ground to eat their picnic.
After the rain, the ground was soft and muddy.
note_fa: سطح زمین؛ on the ground یعنی «روی زمین».

meaning_en: Eat a meal outdoors, often in a park.
example_en: We will have a picnic by the lake.
examples_extra: We will have a picnic in the park tomorrow.
Let's have a picnic by the river on Sunday.

meaning_en: A small mountain.
example_en: We walked up the small hill.
examples_extra: We walked up the hill to see the view.
The house is on top of a small hill.

meaning_en: Without hope; very bad.
example_en: The situation seemed hopeless.
examples_extra: The situation seemed completely hopeless to everyone.
I'm hopeless at maths and always fail tests.

meaning_en: To look after someone or something.
example_en: Can you keep an eye on my bag?
examples_extra: Can you keep my bag for a minute?
Please keep the ticket; we may need it.
note_fa: keep = نگه داشتن و مواظبت کردن.

meaning_en: A large area of water surrounded by land.
example_en: We went swimming in the lake.
examples_extra: We swam in the cold lake yesterday.
The lake is frozen in winter.
note_fa: دریاچه؛ قبل از نام دریاچه the می‌آید.

meaning_en: The green parts that grow on trees.
example_en: The leaves turn red in autumn.
examples_extra: The leaves on the trees are turning brown.
In autumn, fallen leaves cover the garden paths.

meaning_en: a very high natural hill
example_en: We climbed a tall mountain.
examples_extra: We climbed the snowy mountain in five hours.
Fresh snow covers the high mountain tops today.

meaning_en: A large area of protected natural land.
example_en: We visited a beautiful national park.
examples_extra: We camped happily in the vast national park.
The huge national park protects the local wildlife.

meaning_en: All the plants, animals, and things not made by people.
example_en: I love spending time in nature.
examples_extra: We love taking long walks in wild nature.
It is basic human nature to be curious.
note_fa: طبیعت؛ human nature یعنی سرشت انسان.

meaning_en: An area of land without buildings.
example_en: We need more open space in cities.
examples_extra: Children need open space to play.
The park is a large open space.

meaning_en: A narrow way made by people walking.
example_en: We walked along the path through the woods.
examples_extra: We walked along the forest path.
The path leads to the lake.

meaning_en: to take flowers or fruit from a plant.
example_en: Let's go pick some apples.
examples_extra: Pick a card from the pack.
We picked fresh apples from the tree.

meaning_en: a living thing that grows in soil.
example_en: I have many plants in my garden.
examples_extra: Water the plants every day.
This plant needs sunlight to grow.
note_fa: گیاه؛ plant هم اسم است هم فعل.

meaning_en: Buses, trains, etc., for everyone to use.
example_en: I use public transport to get to work.
examples_extra: We use public transport daily.
Public transport is cheap here.

meaning_en: A large natural flow of water to the sea.
example_en: We went fishing in the river.
examples_extra: The river flows through the city centre.
They swam in the river on hot days.
note_fa: نام رودخانه‌ها با the: the Thames.

meaning_en: Parts of a plant under the ground.
example_en: Tree roots grow deep in the soil.
examples_extra: The tree's roots damaged the pavement.
She is proud of her Irish roots.

meaning_en: The natural features of a landscape.
example_en: The mountain scenery was truly beautiful.
examples_extra: The mountain scenery is beautiful.
We stopped to enjoy the scenery.

meaning_en: One of the four periods of the year.
example_en: Spring is a beautiful season for flowers.
examples_extra: Which season do you like best?
Winter is the coldest season of the year.
note_fa: برای فصل‌ها the می‌آید: in the winter.

meaning_en: The sport of moving over snow on skis.
example_en: Skiing is fun in winter.
examples_extra: We went skiing last year.
Skiing is fun but hard.

meaning_en: The time when the sun disappears below the horizon.
example_en: We watched the beautiful sunset over the sea.
examples_extra: We watched the sunset together.
The sunset was beautiful last evening.

meaning_en: Having things all around you.
example_en: The village is surrounded by beautiful mountains.
examples_extra: We were surrounded by beautiful mountains.
The house is surrounded by trees.

meaning_en: The most positive or negative aspect.
example_en: The best thing about summer is the long days.
examples_extra: The best thing about the job is the friendly team.
The worst thing about winter is the short dark days.
note_fa: بهترین یا بدترین جنبه یک موضوع.

meaning_en: A place with houses, shops, and people.
example_en: I live in a small town.
examples_extra: We live in a small and quiet town.
Our little town has a beautiful old church.
note_fa: شهر کوچک؛ از city کوچک‌تر است.

meaning_en: A large vehicle used on farms.
example_en: The farmer drove his tractor in the field.
examples_extra: The old farmer drove his big red tractor.
A powerful tractor easily pulled the heavy trailer.

meaning_en: A tall plant with a thick trunk and branches.
example_en: The bird built a nest in the tall tree.
examples_extra: A big tree grows in our garden.
Birds sat in the tall tree.

meaning_en: Not in bed; awake and out of bed.
example_en: I was up early this morning.
examples_extra: The baby is still up.
He stayed up all night.
note_fa: be up یعنی بیدار بودن (از رختخواب بیرون).

meaning_en: a low area between hills or mountains
example_en: The river flows through the green valley.
examples_extra: The village is in a valley.
We walked through the valley.

meaning_en: a very small town in the countryside
example_en: I live in a small village.
examples_extra: She grew up in a tiny fishing village.
Our little village has just one small shop.

meaning_en: To move by putting one foot in front of the other.
example_en: We like to walk in the park.
examples_extra: We always walk to school together every day.
She walks surprisingly fast for her age indeed.
note_fa: راه رفتن؛ go for a walk.

meaning_en: animals and plants living in nature
example_en: We must protect our wildlife.
examples_extra: There is rich wildlife in the north.
We must protect local wildlife.

meaning_en: Material from trees, used for building.
example_en: The table is made of wood.
examples_extra: The table is made of wood.
He chopped some wood for the fire.

meaning_en: A small forest with many trees.
example_en: Let's walk in the woods.
examples_extra: We walked through the woods.
The path led into the woods.

meaning_en: To find or experience something in a place.
example_en: You get many old buildings in this city.
examples_extra: You get great views from here.
You don't get snow in summer.
